name: Sculpfun S9 5W
tagline: 5W Sculpfun's proven budget line — still popular for value-focused makers
tldr: Sculpfun S9 5W is the 5W SKU on the Sculpfun sculpfun s9 line. Before S30 Ultra, the S9 was Sculpfun's workhorse. Verify optical power on the listing — do not assume combined-watt marketing.
mainObjective: Entry-level hobby engraving on wood, leather, and coated metal with light cutting

priceRange.note: 5W optical module — verify SKU before buying

engraveExample.description: Filled photo or logo on birch plywood

cutExample.description: Simple square cut-out from 3 mm basswood

cons: Slower than S30 Ultra on same jobs
New buyers often better served by S30 Ultra sales
Air assist recommended for clean cuts
beginnerNotes: Choose 5W if it matches your typical jobs. Compare cut depth and price against other tiers in this product line before ordering.
proTips: S9 community mods (air assist, extended feet) are well documented — search Sculpfun Facebook groups before your first big project.
primaryUse: Budget Sculpfun open-frame for wood/leather engraving and light thin-wood cutting.
